PM Modi Visit Bihar : piem narendr modi ne aaj bihar ka daura kiya, jis par jharkhand men siyasat jor pakar chuki hai... JMM aur kangres ne kendr sarkar par jharkhand ke sath sautela bartav karne ka aarop lagaya hai... rajy ke svasthy mantri irphan ansari ka kahna hai - piem sirph chunav ke vakt aate hain, uske bad jharkhand ko bhul jate hain... udhar, BJP ne palatvar kiya hai
